macros.name: lscAct
macros.doc: The atomic command draws a rectangular action symbol annotated with label.

macros.name: lscActor
macros.doc: The \lscActor, \lscClock, and \lscEnv draw the symbols which are used to mark the actor, clock, and environment instance line.

macros.name: lscAsyn
macros.doc: If \lscAsynSnd and \lscAsynRcv occurred exactly once within an FullLsc or Lsc environment, then a following \lscAsyn command with the same id draws the arrow annotated with label.

macros.name: lscAtom
macros.doc: The \lscAtom command marks the (atom(s) at the) current location with a dashed circle and equips it with an identity id.

macros.name: lscBalloon
macros.doc: The \lscBalloon command draws think balloons that are used to provide binding expressions of symbolic instances.

macros.name: lscClock
macros.doc: The \lscActor, \lscClock, and \lscEnv draw the symbols which are used to mark the actor, clock, and environment instance line.

macros.name: lscCut
macros.doc: The \lscCut atomic command draws a vertical line at the current position indicating the location of the cut on the current instance line.

macros.name: lscEnv
macros.doc: The \lscActor, \lscClock, and \lscEnv draw the symbols which are used to mark the actor, clock, and environment instance line.

macros.name: lscEnvLine
macros.doc: The \lscEnvLine behaves just like \lscLine, only the instance line segment is rendered differently, namely in Sequence Diagram style.

macros.name: lscFooterHeightFactor
macros.doc: \lscFooterHeightFactor (default: 0.2) affects the appearance of instance footers.

macros.name: lscKill
macros.doc: The atomic \lscKill command draws a cross at the current position to indicate termination of the instance.

macros.name: lscLabelAtomAt
macros.doc: The command \lscLabelAtomAt puts the label at position angle relative to the atom mark with identity id.

macros.name: lscLine
macros.doc: The \lscLine command draws the elements belonging to the location where the line starts, draws the instance line segment of length length, and advances the vertical position by this amount.

macros.name: lscLocationHeight
macros.doc: The LSC’s box boundary is basically computed in terms of the width and height of a single location within an instance (cf. Figure 2) as defined by lengths \lscLocationWidth (default: 3 pstricks units) and \lscLocationHeight (default: 1 pstricks unit).

macros.name: lscLocationWidth
macros.doc: The LSC’s box boundary is basically computed in terms of the width and height of a single location within an instance (cf. Figure 2) as defined by lengths \lscLocationWidth (default: 3 pstricks units) and \lscLocationHeight (default: 1 pstricks unit).

macros.name: lscLocinv
macros.doc: The \lscLocinv command renders the local invariant id.

macros.name: lscLocinvBegin
macros.doc: The commands \lscLocinvBegin (or, synonymously, \lscLocinvStart) and \lscLocinvEnd mark the beginning and end position of local invariant id.

macros.name: lscLocinvEnd
macros.doc: The commands \lscLocinvBegin (or, synonymously, \lscLocinvStart) and \lscLocinvEnd mark the beginning and end position of local invariant id.

macros.name: lscLocinvOffset
macros.doc: The length \lscLocinvOffset (default: 0) is added to the horizontal distance between instance line and local invariant.

macros.name: lscLocinvStart
macros.doc: The commands \lscLocinvBegin (or, synonymously, \lscLocinvStart) and \lscLocinvEnd mark the beginning and end position of local invariant id.

macros.name: lscPut
macros.doc: The \lscPut command typesets stuff at the current location.

macros.name: lscSetCutColour
macros.doc: The command \lscSetCutColour sets the colour to the colour name colour (default: red), \lscSetCutLinestyle sets the line style to linestyle (default: solid), and \lscSetCutWidth sets the width to length (default: 3pt).

macros.name: lscSetCutWidth
macros.doc: The command \lscSetCutColour sets the colour to the colour name colour (default: red), \lscSetCutLinestyle sets the line style to linestyle (default: solid), and \lscSetCutWidth sets the width to length (default: 3pt).

macros.name: lscTimeout
macros.doc: The atomic commands \lscTimerSet, \lscTimerReset, and \lscTimeout render the timer symbols.

macros.name: lscTimerSet
macros.doc: The atomic commands \lscTimerSet, \lscTimerReset, and \lscTimeout render the timer symbols.

macros.name: lscWidecondOff
macros.doc: The \lscWidecondOn and \lscWidecondOff commands add locations to a wide condition.

macros.name: lscWidecondOn
macros.doc: The \lscWidecondOn and \lscWidecondOff commands add locations to a wide condition.

envs.name: coregion
envs.doc: The elements and instance line segments enclosed in a coregion environment are marked with a parallel dotted line to indicate that they form a coregion.

envs.name: FullLsc
envs.doc: The FullLsc and Lsc environments draw LSC charts with and without header, the lscinst and lsccreateinst environments draw instances within LSCs, and the coregion and simregion environments mark coregions and simultaneous regions within instances.

envs.name: Lsc
envs.doc: The Lsc environment is provided to typeset LSCs without header and LSCs without surrounding frame indicating the quantification.

envs.name: lsccreateinst
envs.doc: The FullLsc and Lsc environments draw LSC charts with and without header, the lscinst and lsccreateinst environments draw instances within LSCs, and the coregion and simregion environments mark coregions and simultaneous regions within instances.

envs.name: simregion
envs.doc: The elements enclosed in a simregion environment are marked with a large dot to explicitly indicate that they lie in a simultaneous region.
